source: teacher replay of stored entering states, bf16, both CFG branches in one batch

cell_scope.cell: one prompt, one denoising step, one CFG branch, one layer, one head; no pooling across any of them
cell_scope.logit: full 128-dim head, post-RoPE, divided by sqrt(128); exact sum of the 64 pair contributions
cell_scope.queries: every video token (attention/top-1 fields: every query_stride-th token)
cell_scope.keys: every video token on all three axes; not restricted to axis lines
cell_scope.row_centring: contributions are taken relative to each query's own mean over all keys
cell_scope.variance_fields: exact over all query x key combinations, float64 second moments
cell_scope.attention_fields: softmax over all keys of the fp32 logits; pooled fields are means over queries of per-query sums, so their ratios are ratios of sums over queries
cell_scope.quantile_fields: quantiles across queries of per-query shares, levels (0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95)
cell_scope.centers: fp32 mean of normalized pre-RoPE Q/K over all tokens of the same cell

reading: every array ends with the 7 quantile levels; 'all' pools every prompt x layer x step x branch x head cell; by_layer / by_step / by_branch pool the remaining cells; per-pair arrays are [..., pair, level]. Distributions are over cells, never means over cells.

pair_center_r.scope: per (cell, pair): pooled row-centred correlation, over every query x every key, between the pair's actual contribution and its center-model contribution. Undefined (excluded from these quantiles and counted here) where the center-model contribution's row variance is not above variance_floor x (|E q_f| |E k_f|)^2 / 128, i.e. within rounding noise of zero; quantiles are over the defined entries

concentration.scope: per cell: the 64 var_own_share values sorted descending and accumulated; counts[k] = number of cells needing exactly k pairs

largest_pair_counts.scope: number of cells whose largest share is pair f

head.scope: per cell. interference_ratio = row_var / sum_f var_own (>1: pairs reinforce each other); center_logit_r = pooled row-centred correlation of the center-model logit with the actual logit over every query x key; center_explained_share = Cov(center logit, actual logit) / row_var; effective_keys, pmax, top1_self are means / fractions over the cell's queries

amplitude.scope: per cell; Spearman across its 64 pairs; axis_dominant_three_pairs = summed share of the three pairs with the largest amplitude inside t, h and w (the pairs of the sweep's scatter figures)

center_r_vs_mrl_counts.scope: number of (cell, pair) entries with a defined center_pair_r, by min(MRL_Q, MRL_K) of the pair (rows) and the pooled row-centred correlation between the pair's actual and center-model contribution (columns)

cross_prompt_stability.scope: per layer x step x branch x head cell: each prompt's 64 shares against the per-pair median over prompts (Spearman across pairs; number of pairs shared by the two largest-22 sets); range_over_prompts[pair] = distribution over cells of max - min over prompts

reference.scope: per prompt x cell. union = pairs selected on Q or K in that cell (a pair zeroed on either side contributes nothing); union_<share> = sum of the cell's pair shares over the union; union_deleted_logit_variance = sum_{f,g in union} pair_cov = row-centred variance of the removed logit part / row variance of the full logit, every query x key; lowest_own_share_set = the smallest value any set of `pairs` pairs can reach in var_own_share; Spearman across the 64 pairs of a cell between damage_q + damage_k (select_pairs.py, pooled over its calibration prompts) and this prompt's var_own. Selection exemptions (layer 0, step 1) are not applied.
